description: radinject provides a simulated air-traffic-control environment for studying false-data injection against radar-based state estimation. The provider is QDucasse (repository owner). Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository represents simulated aircraft and radar measurements, not a live control system. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support aviation sensor-failure and cyber-disruption simulation. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
